**Issue #2603 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #2603: Patch: the AI prices a Field Spell's Activate, as it already prices a Unit's
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
The practice AI already knows that a Unit with a reusable button (an Activate) is worth keeping on its own side and worth removing on the other. It does not know this yet for Field Spells, the backrow cards that offer the same kind of button every turn: Heroic Power, The Power to Punish, The Power to Thrive, Money Machine, Claude's Datacenter and 17 more. It values them by their cost alone, so it plays them rarely and never treats the opponent's as a threat. Once this is built, it counts one use of such a button for either side, the same way it does for Units.

## Why
- `price_uses` walks only `active_units_of` (`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs:1537`), and so does `has_activate_unit` (`:1571-1575`). The backrow loop in `material` (`:742-786`) adds the turn-hook price at `:760` but no activation price. R2564000's text says "a unit's Activate".
- The opponent model already plays a face-up Field Spell's Activate in its reply (`visible_source` and `visible_activation`, `crates/ai/src/reply.rs:383-417`). So the reply sees these abilities and the evaluation does not.
- `catalog.json` has 22 non-token Field Spells that print an Activate: core-098, classic-007, -020, -023, -064, -074, -078, -081, -084, classicplus-007, -031, -060, -078, meditative-054, -075, -080, stinkyscape-039, -112, -125, -148, -157.
- In the sweep pass-2 tables (`training/history/sweep-*.md`, recorded before R2564000), most of them sit at the bottom:

| Card | Id | Played on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The Narcor Project | stinkyscape-039 | 13 of 299 affordable turns |
| Ever Growing Tree | meditative-075 | about 12% |
| Jlockeed's Spacerace Propaganda | stinkyscape-125 | about 13% |
| Claude's Datacenter | classicplus-078 | about 15% |

The pass-2 median is about 20%.

## Proposal
Extend R2564000's probe to backrow cards the seat can read:
- `price_uses` also walks the controller's face-up backrow cards with abilities (`subsystems::abilities_of`). It never probes a card the seat cannot read or a determinized one (`hidden`).
- `has_activate_unit` also counts those cards.
- `material`'s backrow loop adds `w.activation` times the card's activation price, as it already does for `turn_hook`.
- It keeps the same `AI_ACTIVATION_PROBE_NODES` budget and the same `Prices` value. It stays off in `GREEDY_EVAL`, whose `activation` is 0.
- A new ruling in the issue's block amends R2564000, and the change is described in `crates/ai/README.md`.

## Where it lands
`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, `crates/ai/tests/ai/activations.rs`, `crates/ai/README.md`, `spec/rulings/` (a new note, plus R2564000 amended), `spec/pending/<issue>.md`. SPEC §9.9.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A test shows that an own face-up The Power to Punish (classic-020) raises the seat's evaluation by its activation price over the same board without it, and that an enemy one lowers it.
- [ ] A test shows that an enemy backrow card the seat cannot read is never probed, and that two states differing only in it give the same price.
- [ ] A Unit's activation price is unchanged (the existing R2564000 tests pass).
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` passes, and the sweep's perf yardstick holds.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.

## Size and risks
Medium, about 5 files. The risks are the probe's node and time cost on a backrow full of Field Spells, which the shared budget caps, and the usual re-recording of the practice-claim fixture and golden traces that every AI pricing change needs.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-8` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41236654739)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

The AI prices a face-up backrow card's Activate by one use, the way R2564000 prices a unit's. Field Spells such as Classic #20 The Power to Punish are the main case, and both the seat's cards and the enemy's count. The probes, the `AI_ACTIVATION_PROBE_NODES` budget, the key and `Prices` stay the same, and a face-down or hidden card is never probed. `material` adds `AI_EVAL.activation` of the price, inside the Brittle share. `GREEDY_EVAL` reads nothing, and a Unit's price is unchanged. R2603000 amends R2564000 and §9.9, and the README describes the change.

## Steps

`is_standing_unit` and `subsystems` are already imported in `evaluate.rs`.

1. **`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, new helper.** Directly below `has_activate_unit` (around line 1575), add:

```rust
/// R2564000, R2603000: the cards of `player`'s whose Activates the probes try, in this order: each unit
/// acting on its field (`active_units_of`: never a Dormant card), then each card acting face-up in its
/// backrow (`is_acting_on_field`: never a face-down card), a Field Spell among them, but for a Unit
/// standing there, which is one of its units already (R1081000).
fn activate_sources(state: &GameState, player: PlayerId) -> Vec<&CardInstance> {
    let mut cards = active_units_of(state, player);
    cards.extend(
        state.players[player]
            .backrow
            .iter()
            .flatten()
            .filter(|card| !is_standing_unit(state, card) && subsystems::is_acting_on_field(state, card)),
    );
    cards
}
```

2. **Same file, `has_activate_unit`.** Replace the whole function and its doc comment with:

```rust
/// R2564000, R2603000: whether any card the probes would try for `player` (`activate_sources`) has an
/// ability to use (`abilities_of`).
fn has_activate_card(world: &GameState, player: PlayerId) -> bool {
    activate_sources(world, player)
        .into_iter()
        .any(|card| !subsystems::abilities_of(world, card).is_empty())
}
```

In `activation_prices`, change both calls `has_activate_unit(world, seat)` and `has_activate_unit(world, seat.opponent())` to `has_activate_card`.

3. **Same file, `price_uses`.** Change `for unit in active_units_of(turn, controller) {` to `for unit in activate_sources(turn, controller) {`. Leave the loop body unchanged.

4. **Same file, `material`.** In the backrow loop's `Some(def) if readable_by(state, card, seat) =>` arm, directly after `value += w.turn_hook * turn_hook_price(state, card, w, prices);`, add:

```

7. **`spec/rulings/R2603000.md` (new):**

```markdown
---
id: R2603000
title: "The AI's evaluation prices a face-up backrow card's Activate, a Field Spell's, by one use, the seat's and the enemy's (issue #2603)"
cards: "§9.9, R185, R186, R384, R1081000, R2564000, R2565000; Classic #20, #81; C+ #78; Stinkyscape #39"
proven_in:

---
Amends [[R2564000]], which priced the Activate of a unit acting on either field and left a backrow card's out. Twenty-two shipped Field Spells print an Activate their controller can use every turn ([[R384]]), Classic #20 The Power to Punish, Classic #81 The Power to Thrive and Classic+ #78 Claude's Datacenter among them, and the AI's evaluation counted each by its cost alone: it played them rarely, and an enemy's never counted as a threat, though the opponent's reply already plays a face-up one (`visible_activation`). No Hearthstone rule is involved: the evaluation changes no game.

**What it counts.** What [[R2564000]] counts, for more cards. At the start of each player's turn the probes reach, after that player's units, the AI tries the Activates of each card acting face-up in that player's backrow (`activate_sources`): a Field Spell, or a Trap or Field Trap once it is face-up, but never a Unit standing there, which is one of the units already ([[R1081000]]). Each is tried, priced and keyed (definition, face, controller) as a unit is. A card of the seat's own makes the probes play the second turn end, as a unit of its own does, and every card shares `AI_ACTIVATION_PROBE_NODES` ([[R186]]'s budget), which stays 20. `material` adds `AI_EVAL.activation` of the price for each backrow card the seat can read, on either side, inside the card's Brittle share as `unit_worth` adds a unit's: a card that crumbles, Stinkyscape #39 The Narcor Project, takes its coming uses with it. The weight stays 0.5 (at 0.5 the smoke gate read <R>, <G> and <H> of 20, against random, against greedy and as Hard against Easy) and the frozen `GREEDY_EVAL` keeps 0. An Animated backrow card waiting to be a Unit reads its price again in the share of it `material` counts as a Unit (`unit_worth`), as its turn hooks do ([[R2565000]]); no shipped Animated card prints an Activate.

**What is not priced.**
- A face-down card, the seat's or the enemy's, which is never probed ([[R185]]), and a card in a hand or a library.
- Everything else [[R2564000]] does not price.

**Rejected.** Adding the price outside the Brittle share, as [[R2565000]] adds a turn hook's, since a Brittle card's coming uses crumble with it as a unit's do; a budget of its own for backrow cards, which would draw more of the decision's nodes; and taking the use back out of an Animated card's waiting Unit, for a case no shipped card has.
```

## Tests

`crates/ai/tests/ai/activations.rs`:
- Add `const PUNISH: &str = "classic-020";` after `MY_PAWN`.
- End the header with: "//!\n//! R2603000 prices a face-up backrow card's Activate the same way, a Field Spell's: The Power to Punish (classic-020), a (3) Field Spell, \"Activate: Choose one: Deal 2 Pierce damage; your opponent discards 1 random card; or choose a Unit, which is destroyed at the start of your next turn\", once a turn."
- Append these tests. They use the file's `board`, `priced`, `prices_of` and `price_of`:

```rust
#[test]
fn r2603000_an_own_power_to_punish_raises_the_evaluation_by_its_price() {
    let state = board(
        "ai-activation-field-spell-own",
        json!({ "backrow": [PUNISH] }),
        json!({ "hand": [VANILLA], "field": [SORCERER] }),
    );
    let unpriced = evaluate(&state, AI, NextSwing::Enemy, &AI_EVAL);
    let (prices, used) = priced(&state);
    let price = price_of(&prices, PUNISH, AI);
    assert!(price > 0.0, "a use punishes the enemy: {price}");
    assert!(
        (3..=AI_ACTIVATION_PROBE_NODES).contains(&used),
        "two turn ends and a use at least: {used}"
    );
    let prices = prices_of(prices);
    let eval = evaluate_priced(&state, AI, NextSwing::Enemy, &AI_EVAL, &prices);
    assert!(
        (eval - (unpriced + AI_EVAL.activation * price)).abs() < 1e-9,
        "{eval} against {unpriced} and {price}"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        evaluate_priced(&state, AI, NextSwing::Enemy, &GREEDY_EVAL, &prices),
        evaluate(&state, AI, NextSwing::Enemy, &GREEDY_EVAL),
        "the frozen baseline reads no price"
    );
}

#[test]
fn r2603000_an_enemy_power_to_punish_lowers_the_evaluation_by_its_price() {
    let state = board(
        "ai-activation-field-spell-enemy",
        json!({ "hand": [VANILLA], "field": [SORCERER] }),
        json!({ "backrow": [PUNISH] }),
    );
    let unpriced = evaluate(&state, AI, NextSwing::Enemy, &AI_EVAL);
    let (prices, _) = priced(&state);
    let price = price_of(&prices, PUNISH, HUMAN);
    assert!(price > 0.0, "a use punishes the AI: {price}");
    let eval = evaluate_priced(&state, AI, NextSwing::Enemy, &AI_EVAL, &prices_of(prices));
    assert!(
        (eval - (unpriced - AI_EVAL.activation * price)).abs() < 1e-9,
        "{eval} against {unpriced} and {price}"
    );
}

#[test]
fn r2603000_an_enemy_face_down_card_is_never_probed_and_changes_no_price() {
    let a = board(
        "ai-activation-field-spell-hidden",
        json!({ "backrow": [PUNISH] }),
        json!({ "hand": [VANILLA], "field": [SORCERER], "backrow": [SHEEPISH] }),
    );
    let mut b = a.clone();
    b.players[HUMAN]
        .backrow
        .iter_mut()
        .flatten()
        .next()
        .expect("the enemy's Trap is set")
        .def_id = MY_PAWN.to_string();
    let (on_a, on_b) = (priced(&a), priced(&b));
    assert!(price_of(&on_a.0, PUNISH, AI) > 0.0);
    assert!(
        on_a.0.iter().all(|entry| entry.controller == AI),
        "only the AI's Power to Punish is priced: {on_a:?}"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        on_a, on_b,
        "the enemy's face-down Trap changes no price and no node"
    );
}
```

Run on the change, both Powers to Punish priced 5.5, and the probes spent 6 and 5 nodes. Without the change, each test panics in `price_of`. The seven `r2564000_*` tests must pass unchanged; they prove a Unit's price is unchanged.

```

cargo test -p jackioh-ai
cargo fmt --check
cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings

## Done when

- [ ] Steps 1–5 are in.
- [ ] The three `r2603000_*` tests pass, and so does all of `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`.
- [ ] R2603000 is written with the gate's numbers. R2564000, §9.9, `spec/pending/2603.md` and the README are updated.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` exits 0.
- [ ] The harness checks pass: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests and web tests.

## Risks

- **Hidden information (R185):** only cards `is_acting_on_field` passes are walked, so a face-down card is never probed. The `hidden` check still skips the enemy's hand and library, and `material` reads a price only where `readable_by` holds.
- **Budget:** backrow cards share the 20-node cap, which the existing budget test and the perf gate hold. Do not raise it.
- **Determinism:** the change adds no draw and no collection in hash order. The golden traces, fuzz and the practice-claim fixture are unaffected; practice claims stopped re-running the AI with R2560000.
- **Gate:** if it fails, report its lines. Never tune `AI_EVAL.activation` to pass.

## Open questions

None block the build. Three decisions were made here, and a person may overrule any of them:
- The price goes inside the Brittle share, as a unit's Activate does. The rejected alternative was outside it, as a turn hook's.
- The budget is shared, not a second one.
- An Animated waiting card is counted twice, as its turn hooks already are. No shipped Animated card prints an Activate.
````

````markdown
# Plan (opus, strong)

## Goal

The AI prices a face-up backrow card's Activate by one use, the way R2564000 prices a unit's. Field Spells such as Classic #20 The Power to Punish are the main case, and both the seat's cards and the enemy's count. The probes, the `AI_ACTIVATION_PROBE_NODES` budget, the key and `Prices` stay the same, and a face-down or hidden card is never probed. `material` adds `AI_EVAL.activation` of the price, inside the Brittle share. `GREEDY_EVAL` reads nothing, and a Unit's price is unchanged. R2603000 amends R2564000 and §9.9, and the README describes the change.

## Files to touch

| Path | | What changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` | change | `activate_sources` (new), `has_activate_card` (renamed), `price_uses`, `material`, docs |
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | two doc comments, no value |
| `crates/ai/src/decide.rs` | change | the comment above `let deaths = death_prices(...)` only |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/activations.rs` | change | header paragraph, `PUNISH` const, three `r2603000_*` tests |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | change | the "A unit's Activate counts by one use" sentence (lines 95–99) |
| `spec/rulings/R2603000.md` | new | the ruling |
| `spec/rulings/R2564000.md` | change | two bullets of "What is not priced", the end of "Rejected" |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | §9.9's **Evaluation** bullet: one sentence added |
| `spec/pending/2603.md` | new | the §11 paragraph (creates the directory) |

Do not touch: `crates/engine/`, `crates/cards/` (no patches fragment: no card plays differently), `crates/ai/src/reply.rs`, any constant's value, `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `apps/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `bot/`. Never run `cargo jackioh spec index`. Governing: SPEC §9.9; R2564000 (amended), R2565000, R185, R186, R384, R1081000.

## Steps

`is_standing_unit` and `subsystems` are already imported in `evaluate.rs`.

1. **`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, new helper.** Directly below `has_activate_unit` (around line 1575), add:

```rust
/// R2564000, R2603000: the cards of `player`'s whose Activates the probes try, in this order: each unit
/// acting on its field (`active_units_of`: never a Dormant card), then each card acting face-up in its
/// backrow (`is_acting_on_field`: never a face-down card), a Field Spell among them, but for a Unit
/// standing there, which is one of its units already (R1081000).
fn activate_sources(state: &GameState, player: PlayerId) -> Vec<&CardInstance> {
    let mut cards = active_units_of(state, player);
    cards.extend(
        state.players[player]
            .backrow
            .iter()
            .flatten()
            .filter(|card| !is_standing_unit(state, card) && subsystems::is_acting_on_field(state, card)),
    );
    cards
}
```

2. **Same file, `has_activate_unit`.** Replace the whole function and its doc comment with:

```rust
/// R2564000, R2603000: whether any card the probes would try for `player` (`activate_sources`) has an
/// ability to use (`abilities_of`).
fn has_activate_card(world: &GameState, player: PlayerId) -> bool {
    activate_sources(world, player)
        .into_iter()
        .any(|card| !subsystems::abilities_of(world, card).is_empty())
}
```

In `activation_prices`, change both calls `has_activate_unit(world, seat)` and `has_activate_unit(world, seat.opponent())` to `has_activate_card`.

3. **Same file, `price_uses`.** Change `for unit in active_units_of(turn, controller) {` to `for unit in activate_sources(turn, controller) {`. Leave the loop body unchanged.

4. **Same file, `material`.** In the backrow loop's `Some(def) if readable_by(state, card, seat) =>` arm, directly after `value += w.turn_hook * turn_hook_price(state, card, w, prices);`, add:

```rust
                // R2603000: what one use of its Activate gives its controller, as the decision's root priced
                // it, inside its Brittle share as a unit's is (R2564000): a card that crumbles takes its
                // coming uses with it. Either side's; an enemy face-down card is not here.
                value += brittle_share(card, w) * w.activation * activation_price(state, card, w, prices);
```

5. **Doc comments only, no code.** Keep lines at 110 columns or fewer, and reflow what you touch.
   - `evaluate.rs`:
     - In the module header, after "`unit_worth` reads the prices it passes it (`Prices`)", add "; #2603 prices a face-up backrow card's the same way, a Field Spell's, `material` reading them (R2603000)".
     - In the docs of `ActivationPrice`, `activation_price`, `price_uses`, `probe_turns` and `activation_prices`, write `R2564000, R2603000:`, and say "card" wherever a probed "unit" is meant.
     - In `activation_prices`, replace "(`active_units_of`, so never a Dormant card, a face-down backrow card or a hand card)" with "and of each card acting face-up in either backrow (`activate_sources`, so never a Dormant card, a face-down card or a hand card)".
   - `config.rs`:
     - At the end of `EvalWeights::activation`'s doc, add "R2603000: `material` adds it, inside the card's Brittle share, for each backrow card the seat can read, on either side."
     - In `AI_ACTIVATION_PROBE_NODES`'s doc, write `R2564000, R2603000:`, and make "about four units" read "about four cards, units and face-up backrow cards together".
   - `decide.rs`: replace the five comment lines above `let deaths = death_prices(&probe, seat, counter);` with:

```rust
    // R2424000, R2477000, R2564000, R2565000, R2603000: every Death the seat can read, every turn hook of
    // the cards it can read on either board and of its hand's Field Spells and Units, and each Activate of
    // a Unit on either field or of a face-up backrow card on either side, priced once on the probe world
    // for the whole decision, their probes drawn from the searched section's nodes; all are priced before
    // any is passed, so no probe reads a price, and every step below is passed them (`Prices`).
```

6. **`crates/ai/README.md`, lines 95–99.** Replace "A unit's Activate counts … for both sides' units." with:

> A unit's Activate counts by one use (R2564000), and so does a face-up backrow card's, a Field Spell's (R2603000): at the root `activation_prices` ends the seat's turn and then the enemy's, within `AI_ACTIVATION_PROBE_NODES`; at the start of each player's next turn it tries that player's units' uses, then its face-up backrow cards' (`activate_sources`), as the reply does (`visible_activation`), and prices the best as the controller's evaluation after less before, each crystal at `next_turn_mana`; `unit_worth` adds `AI_EVAL.activation` of it for both sides' units, and `material` for each readable backrow card, inside its Brittle share.

Wrap it at about 105 columns.

7. **`spec/rulings/R2603000.md` (new):**

```markdown
---
id: R2603000
title: "The AI's evaluation prices a face-up backrow card's Activate, a Field Spell's, by one use, the seat's and the enemy's (issue #2603)"
cards: "§9.9, R185, R186, R384, R1081000, R2564000, R2565000; Classic #20, #81; C+ #78; Stinkyscape #39"
proven_in:
  - crates/ai/tests/ai/activations.rs
---
Amends [[R2564000]], which priced the Activate of a unit acting on either field and left a backrow card's out. Twenty-two shipped Field Spells print an Activate their controller can use every turn ([[R384]]), Classic #20 The Power to Punish, Classic #81 The Power to Thrive and Classic+ #78 Claude's Datacenter among them, and the AI's evaluation counted each by its cost alone: it played them rarely, and an enemy's never counted as a threat, though the opponent's reply already plays a face-up one (`visible_activation`). No Hearthstone rule is involved: the evaluation changes no game.

**What it counts.** What [[R2564000]] counts, for more cards. At the start of each player's turn the probes reach, after that player's units, the AI tries the Activates of each card acting face-up in that player's backrow (`activate_sources`): a Field Spell, or a Trap or Field
````
